tagline: A global leader in luxury goods and jewelry
hero_kpi_rationale: Richemont is a global leader in luxury goods whose business model relies on heritage brand valuation and pricing power. The 68.1% gross margin reflects the intrinsic value of its collections and the group's commercial strength in the luxury sector.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue amounts to €20.616 billion in 2024, up 3.3% from €19.953 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by luxury goods demand

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 68.1% in 2024 (€14,036M gross profit on €20,616M revenue), compared to 68.7% in 2023 (€13,716M on €19,953M), reflecting the strong pricing power and value of luxury products.
kpis.signal: Strong margin typical of luxury goods

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 23.3% in 2024 (€4,794M on €20,616M revenue) from 25.2% in 2023 (€5,031M on €19,953M), due to higher distribution and communication expenses.
kpis.signal: Operating margin compression from cost pressures

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses represent approximately 0.5% of revenue, consistent with a business model based on brand heritage and creative design rather than technological innovation.
kpis.signal: Low R&D typical of heritage-based luxury model

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on acquisition or modernization of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amount to €700 million in 2024, up 16.7% from €600 million in 2023, primarily dedicated to boutiques, workshops, and artisanal production facilities.
kpis.signal: Capex investments in retail and manufacturing

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the group.
kpis.description: The group employs 38,500 people as of March 2024, up 2.7% from 37,500 employees in 2023, strengthening customer service and production capabilities.
kpis.signal: Workforce growth to enhance customer service

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €41.01 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €13.15 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Increased competition in the luxury market
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned implicitly in the structure of operational segments and differentiation of Maisons, with language indicating the need to preserve exclusive identity. Competition is structural, the sector being saturated and sensitive to perceptions of rarity. Trend stable.

risks.title: Dependence on the reputation of luxury Maisons
risks.score_rationale: Central to Richemont's strategy, with strong emphasis on the distinct identity of each Maison. Language is firm on preserving prestige. Trend stable, high weight in perceived value.

risks.title: Risks related to the digital transition in luxury
risks.score_rationale: Referenced through the sale of YNAP and strategic repositioning. Language is cautious but concerned. Trend rising, as digital becomes critical for reaching younger consumers.

risks.title: Concentration of suppliers for rare raw materials
risks.score_rationale: Not explicit but inferred from jewelry and watchmaking activities. Dependence on precious materials (gold, diamonds) implies supply risks. Trend stable, sector structurally exposed.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of online sales platforms
risks.score_rationale: Linked to YNAP and digital expansion. Although not directly mentioned, the risk is inherent to the growing importance of luxury e-commerce. Trend rising.

risks.title: Management of intellectual property rights
risks.score_rationale: Inferred from brand value and unique designs. Language is not explicit but the risk is underlying. Trend stable, sector traditionally exposed to counterfeiting.

risks.title: Dependence on creative and executive talent
risks.score_rationale: The success of Maisons relies on iconic designers and leaders. Although not cited, the risk is implicit in the artisanal structure. Trend stable.

ai_positioning.summary: Richemont does not mention any significant strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its 2024 annual report.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the Business, MD&A, or Innovation sections.
No references to AI tools for design, production, or customer relationship management.
No deployment of APIs, chatbots, or algorithmic personalization.
